name: Luna Verification Failure Classification And Remediation Standard

MISSING_ARTIFACT.description: Required file or required section is missing.
MISSING_ARTIFACT.rerun_requirement: User must rerun original Final Phase Verifier after fix.

OUTPUT_CONTRACT_DRIFT.description: Output field names/shapes/values drift from verifier contract.
OUTPUT_CONTRACT_DRIFT.rerun_requirement: User must rerun original Final Phase Verifier after fix.

STATIC_IMPORT_OR_SYNTAX_FAILURE.description: Syntax or import failure in verifier/phase assets.
STATIC_IMPORT_OR_SYNTAX_FAILURE.rerun_requirement: User must rerun original Final Phase Verifier after fix.

FIXTURE_CONTRACT_FAILURE.remediation_scope: Fix fixture contract or case mapping only.
FIXTURE_CONTRACT_FAILURE.rerun_requirement: User must rerun original Final Phase Verifier after fix.

RUNTIME_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION.remediation_scope: Remove violating behavior and restore boundary.
RUNTIME_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION.rerun_requirement: User must rerun original Final Phase Verifier after fix.

VERIFIER_DEFECT.description: Verifier logic defect or unstable checker implementation.
VERIFIER_DEFECT.remediation_scope: Fix verifier defect without lowering checks.
VERIFIER_DEFECT.rerun_requirement: User must rerun original Final Phase Verifier after fix.

REAL_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT.remediation_scope: Fix defective implementation under phase boundary.
REAL_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT.rerun_requirement: User must rerun original Final Phase Verifier after fix.

ARCHITECTURE_BLOCKER.description: Upstream architecture dependency or unresolved governance conflict blocks completion.
ARCHITECTURE_BLOCKER.remediation_scope: Produce blocker report and wait for governance decision.
ARCHITECTURE_BLOCKER.rerun_requirement: User reruns original Final Phase Verifier after blocker resolution.
